physical_interval_clock: time.time immediately before first and after last actual applied mj_step; 5kHz samples
physical_time_note: MuJoCo mj_step forces/contact correspond to the integration evaluation, preceding its returned qpos. Force evaluation and post-integration clocks are both stored.
terminal_row_note: Actual final qpos/qvel are appended for physical failure and external truncation; held command and last diagnostic values retain their preceding control timestamp.

wbc.body_target: independent_task_reference_p_v_a; SRB state retained as prediction; no masked_force_or_sacrificed_state_acceleration_target
wbc.stance_kinematics: sphere rolling no-slip contact velocity; normal center/material task; center swing/search PVA
wbc.force_application: native current data.contact.pos; material causal force_boundary_bottom; geometry center-minus-radius otherwise

evidence: At3.3s FR sphere center moves[.03231,.01491]m/s while current contact material point moves[-.000176,.000007]m/s.
At3.7s FL sphere center moves[.01640,.00999]m/s while current contact material point moves[-.000025,.000034]m/s.
Center-anchored stance falsely penalizes native no-slip rolling and generates incompatible joint acceleration.
Reaction Jacobian at center omits actual sphere-bottom moment arms; saved-state generalized reaction difference reaches .474Nm base and .291Nm joint in checked states.
changes: Map reaction via actual native contact point or causal material force_boundary_bottom.
Use sphere rolling Jcenter-skew(r)Jomega and matching derivative for stance tangential contact velocity; retain center PVA for swing/search.
Keep touchdown anchor immutable as event evidence; do not pull rolling sphere center back tangentially; retain normal causal material support task.
Use bottom contact locations for SRB force moments, with center references saved separately.
expected_observables: Near-zero actual contact tangential velocity is no longer penalized as center slip.
Contact force Jacobian matches force application point.
Original WBC torque/input/joint bounds unchanged; physical success remains unproven.

w54_f_recording.command: total feedback torque solved by WBC; u=q+(tau_total+5*v)/60; no added joint PD term
w54_f_recording.model_convention: h=qfrc_bias-qfrc_passive+bounded_reference_direction_dry_friction; contact counted once; no qfrc_constraint copy
w54_f_recording.contact: native current contact or causal material force bottom supplies reaction Jacobian; sphere rolling contact task; actual touchdown anchor retained; measured support and load-bearing handover separated
w54_f_recording.material: measured force, local causal stiffness anchor and current normal velocity; no future material state propagation
w54_f_recording.prediction: centroidal state and explicit kinematic foot references; measured current reaction independent of touchdown/load debounce; no fabricated articulated rollout

physical_foot_kinematics_clock: mj_step evaluation geometry/cvel at force_evaluation_time_s, before returned integration state; world frame
recording: 500Hz control trajectory; physical and prediction streams split every30s on the same uninterrupted clock.

legal_route.criterion: Original base strip x[.8,2.2],abs(y)<=.6 and actual interior-foot Fz>0 at500Hz; return uses reversed boundaries. Signed credit is provisional and retracted on illegal/incomplete passage. New R12 mission evaluation also checks these recorded legal roundtrips.

material.contact_sampling: Pre-integration material force and native forces from the same MuJoCo step.
material.mask_policy: Only soft foot masks disabled; non-foot masks retained. Independent frozen native MPC/FK/reference model.

execution_intent: Standard PPO in the actual S5/Go2/material loop

normalization.finite_task_channels: Always zero for every R11 training and evaluation duration

observer.sampling: Actual elapsed 2 ms; endpoint kinematic boundary. Within-window load/unload is not resolved at 0.2 ms; no true q/e correction.

material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.
